output.summary: The cadence slip is explained by the single-reviewer AppSec gate. Added time sits entirely between QA pass and sign-off (E5). Queue depth and waits grew while reviewer throughput stayed flat and submissions rose (E4). The August full-time delegate cleared the queue and six releases shipped, with no other process change (E6). Non-gated Reporting patches kept a 14-day cadence (E12). Engineering output (E7), technical debt (E11) and the reviewer's per-review time (E4, E6) are unchanged, so discipline, debt and individual slowness are contradicted. Idle tickets are mostly awaiting security review (E9). Preferred action is more review capacity. Suspending the gate or running an accountability program is harmful. Risk-tiered scope redefinition is premature until review outcome data exists (Q1, Q2).
